Project M for Android Add on Pack 2.0 - Compiled by Monsieurtalbot

XDA thread - http://forum.xda-developers.com/showthread.php?p=24490462


Disclaimer: I in NO way take responsibility for any of the work enclosed in this zip archive.
I have simply gathered these presets from various forums/torrents around the web into one place and tested them
in Project M for ANDROID devices.  This is tested to work on HIGHER END (1ghz+) devices.

This is a compilation of various Milkdrop presets not included in the projectM app (probably for copyright reasons)...



DIRECTIONS-

IMPORTANT - Turn off all touch interactive related options in ProjectM settings -
They are NOT compatible with this and it will cause it to Force Close.
You can still change presets with touch, however.

Copy the CONTENTS of the "ProjectM Add on Presets" folder (not the folder itself) to
"/Sdcard/ProjectM" on your device. (THIS IS ON GALAXY SII) - (The folder may be elsewhere, but it will be located on in the
USERroot of your internal SD and will work on any device.)

Depending on whether you've downloaded presets from the app it may ask if you want to overwrite files...  Go ahead and skip
them if you want...  It shouldn't matter either way.

Then start ProjectM, and give it about 10 min (sometimes more) to parse all the new preset files (there's a lot of 'em),\
and VOILA - You have about 9,000 new presets. (From the original 300 available.)  :-)

****IT WILL TAKE A WHILE TO PARSE THE FILES THE FIRST TIME ONLY- Afterwards, it starts immediately.  Don't be impatient -
THERE IS NO STATUS BAR.

You can hit "Menu>Browse Presets" and you will see no presets listed until it finishes the initial start. Only then will it
start visualizing something other than "Project M"...


--IF COMING FROM A PREVIOUS VERSION--

Just go ahead and write over all previous files.

I will update this package as I find more.  Enjoy.
